name: 76-execution-progress-close-questions
body:
[76-execution-progress-close-questions] Full outcome, direct answers

Desired behavior
Ready authorized step executed; direct questions answered; finish after the full result + mandatory checks.

Executable contract
1. Action chosen by the concrete unresolved question whose answer changes the work. Current evidence reused; a reached state needs no invented edit.
2. Failure → attempt changed by the observation. Equivalent retry allowed when a different outcome is reasonably expected, with a limit. Bounded capability probe reports its result; environment repair when assigned or truly necessary in scope.
3. Question/status answered promptly from the latest observation; only the deciding fresh fact fetched. Active task continues unless the user cancelled it.
4. Real requirement change → control-task updated; before compaction new reusable knowledge → agent-state. Such writes create no confirmation/readback/retry gate; a bookkeeping error blocks no authorized work, a materially incomplete storage result reported honestly.
5. Whole outcome + mandatory role/skill gates checked; misses fixed. Sufficient coverage = completion + factual report, no new investigation round for reassurance.

Tools and skills
control_task_set/patch on a requirement change, agent_state_note/checkpoint for new reusable knowledge; task_output/poll per the real background lifecycle. Native tools + existing mechanisms, no parallel task-state system.

Links: 17-user-correction-rebase, 71-user-intent-outcome, 73-tests-not-proof, 75-evidence-or-blocker.

Anti-patterns
Failing command repeated with no new basis; optional lookup before a ready answer; first ready subset as the whole instruction; endless re-checking; declared launch instead of an executed one.
